description: This Dart source file defines a Flutter widget for a Settings screen in a mobile app. It manages network environment loading, profile fetching, and WebSocket connection handling, and provides a user interface with buttons to perform these actions and display relevant status updates.

classes.name: SettingsScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget representing the settings screen of the app, providing options for environment loading, profile fetching, and WebSocket management.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the state, setting up token store and network repository instances.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Cleans up resources such as canceling WebSocket subscriptions when the widget is disposed.

methods.name: _loadEnv
methods.description: Loads the environment configuration asynchronously and updates the UI state accordingly.

methods.name: _fetchProfile
methods.description: Fetches user profile data from the network repository and updates the display.

methods.name: _connectWs
methods.description: Establishes a WebSocket connection and listens for incoming messages, updating the UI.

methods.name: _disconnectWs
methods.description: Disconnects the WebSocket connection and cancels message subscriptions.
